data.narrative:
Volund Manufacturing is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by operators with prior tenure at Anduril, Aerojet Rocketdyne, and Blue Origin. The company has raised $12M to date. The valuation analysis benchmarks against a peer universe of 10 comparable companies: 2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using $12M total raised as a proxy for entry valuation and applying a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage multiplier, implies a $30M valuation. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (UFORCE at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, NODA AI at $125M) yields a $400M median valuation, with a range of $125M to $1.0B.

Triangulation across both methods supports a valuation range of $26M to $460M, with a midpoint of $215M. The wide dispersion reflects meaningful uncertainty around the appropriate peer multiple and stage progression rate for a Seed-stage defense company. Stage-progression anchors conservatively to $26M–$30M; peer-median anchors to $215M–$460M. Key uncertainties include product maturity relative to later-stage peers and whether the executive team's prior exits command a premium. The median of $215M represents a reasonable middle estimate absent additional financial or product-market traction data.
